name: Lisa Lister
reason: Borderline on scope and health. Her own site (lisalister.com, about page) presents her mainly as a writer, illustrator and creative consultant. The only current paid offering is 'Read The Room', a five-month storycraft writing salon (£495 or 5 × £100). Her best-known books (Code Red, Love Your Lady Landscape, Bloody Astrology) are framed around menstrual and womb health. The about page lists Theta Healing, womb yoga and herbal teas and tinctures as a 'medicine keeper'. There are no videos, the only ISBNs on her pages are for two oracle decks, and the base is a UK postcode (PO14) with no town named. That leaves too little in-scope, non-health teaching to make a listing.
